redshift.context_bounds: derive for supervision starting at z=0.01; include available lower-z observations where needed and explicitly represent missing near-observer/outside-footprint support; do not extrapolate existing selection curves
redshift.population_audit: check selected mock coverage and target validity in each low-z bin; evaluate by stellar mass only where validated comparable masses exist, otherwise name any luminosity proxy explicitly

encoder.epochs_policy: freeze equal complete-epoch budget for full and each OOF fit after throughput measurement; no early stopping

summary_export.training_phases: each from its own omitted-phase encoder

posterior_tables.sample_design: include explicit low-z strata after new shell registration

posterior.checkpoint_policy: terminal_fixed_budget; adapt and verify trainer before production
posterior.evaluation: per-phase and per-redshift joint eigenvalue calibration, proper scores, class reliability, sharpness and sampler checks; do not pool away low-z failure

preparation_cpu_budget.scope: initial low-z coverage and preparation canary only, not full 23-phase production rebuild
preparation_cpu_budget.work: catalogue low-z support and valid-label census; observed/context geometry and random-support canary; no fits, no full-volume FFT, no graph build

first_gpu_request.purpose: post-preparation actual-loader throughput, deterministic restart and halo48 memory/timing; disposable weights only

resources.production_policy: explicit separate approval after measured throughput; independent single-GPU fits; no speculative job array

baseline_cost.encoder_gpu_hours_formula: epochs * 6731580 / measured_updates_per_second / 3600, plus validation, exports and posterior; recompute counts after low-z extension

source_freeze.reason: preparation changes are currently uncommitted; preserve them and freeze exact reviewed source/config hashes before launch

blockers: new supervision/geometry/selection/transforms and 20 OOF contracts for that range
post-preparation GPU benchmark and fixed training-budget choice
